race.comment: MYSTERY MINUTE (2) settled well back here last start as the race favourite and never got into the race after an impressive start to the campaign. Faithfull hops on board now and an impressive performance is on the cards. Can bounce back to winning ways. SUNSHINE TAFE (4) rates highly on her form last campaign and has made the switch to the Daly stable. The inside draw is a bonus and a bunch of gear changes can see her return with a bang. SIMPLY ROSSO (1) hit the frame two starts ago at this track but ran below par last time when seventh and beaten 6 lengths over 1200m at this track after being prominent at the bend. Finds a nice race and can bounce back. RIVER BEAUTY (11) produced another moderate effort last start when 16 lengths from the winner in 11th over 1000m at this track. Capable of better. DRAG MACHINE (6) has impressed at the trials coming in and is not to be discounted.
